formulas.formula: Your first paycheck: save some, give some, spend some, and reach your goals faster.
1. Setup: your name, hourly pay, usual hours a week, and how you want to split every paycheck: Save, Give, and Spend.
2. Paychecks: each payday, type the hours you worked (and tips). Type your real take-home if you know it.
3. Every paycheck is split into three jars automatically: Save, Give and Spend.
4. Spending: log what you buy and which jar it comes from (blank = Spend).
5. Goals & Wishlist: see how many HOURS of work something costs, and how many weeks until you can buy it.
6. Paycheck Explained: why your paycheck is smaller than hours x pay (hint: taxes).
Save before you spend. Even 20% of every paycheck adds up fast.
Before you buy something, ask: is it worth 6 hours of my job?
Giving jar money is for gifts, donations and helping others.
Your first paycheck will look smaller than you expect. That's normal! You may get some back when you file taxes.
Clear the white cells on Paychecks, Spending and Goals & Wishlist, then update Setup.
Tinted cells: these calculate for you.
Green: goal reached, or money left.
Red: a jar went below $0, or something to check.
You've got this! Smart money habits start now.
Set this up once. Everything else uses it.
For the goal and paycheck math.
